adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#execute`, `poll_feed` runs only if `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?` (see `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:13-16`). In the spec `it "requires feed_polling_url"` (`spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb`), only `feed_polling_url` is stubbed to `nil`; `feed_polling_enabled?` is not stubbed and the default in `config/site_settings.yml` is `feed_polling_enabled: false`, so `poll_feed` would be skipped even if the URL guard were removed. This makes the test non-specific/ineffective, but it’s a testing issue rather than a runtime defect introduced by the diff.
